annotations.title: List the volumes of a manga series

description: Every Japanese volume of a manga series with the chapters it holds and its English editions on Mangainfo: label, format, publisher, ISBN, release date with precision and the volume page. Takes a slug such as "blue-lock" or a title.

series.description: The slug from a Mangainfo address (mangainfo.com/series/blue-lock is blue-lock) or a title.
